kind: functional and resource qualification; no efficiency comparison or provider billing
resource_scope: trusted frozen two-process reference: controller plus one direct fixture; roles/servers in-process; not an arbitrary descendant tree
execution_mode: direct_asserted_fixture; fresh process per condition; no VSTest parent
wire_scope: both public-client/gateway and gateway/receiver TCP stream bytes including HTTP/TLS, excluding TCP/IP packet overhead
nop_payload_scope: actual serialized Delegate/AlignStream JSON, locally dispatched; not remote NOP wire qualification
model_scope: deterministic plan; no model requests or new provider usage/cost observations
success: exact frozen source-oracle groups, five actual rows, authenticated grants, two owner releases; duplicate has zero new dispatch
failures: seven asserted negative scenarios; lost query terminal and actual post-create audit503 remain indeterminate with no downstream retry; unresolved allocation keys are retained for a separate owner decision and never automatically replayed during cleanup
claims: bounded reference semantics and measured transfer costs only; no NPS superiority, production-runtime/native/six-SDK or release qualification
topology_precondition: reviewed frozen fixture never spawns subprocesses; all-thread scans reject every observed expansion or unavailable scope evidence; sampling is not unconditional fork prevention
memory_bound: sum of controller full-current-program-image VmHWM and full fixture lifetime wait4 RSS maximum, each augmented by a higher actual procfs HWM; no baseline subtraction
kernel_units: Linux KiB, multiplied by 1024 exactly once
procfs_scope: 10ms concurrent RSS diagnostic; errors visibly retained, not authority when complete exact-PID kernel accounting exists
controller_image_scope: current Python program image, including all setup/baseline memory; no exec/clear_refs/HWM reset after entry; inherited pre-exec SELF usage retained as diagnostic only
